# Hey Jude Cotton Clothing Company

> Hey Jude makes 100% cotton pajamas for kids in sizes 4–12, in prints picked by a kid. Tagline: Pajamas by kids, for kids. Website: https://shopheyjude.com/

## Products
- [Flower Set](https://shopheyjude.com/products/flower-set): ivory 100% cotton button-front pajama top and pants with a peach-and-green floral print and a small navy logo on the chest pocket.
- [Checker Set](https://shopheyjude.com/products/checker-set): blue 100% cotton crewneck top with a small navy logo, with sage-and-cream checker pajama pants.
- Price: $35 per set (U.S. dollars).
- Sizes: XS · Twinkle (4–5), S · Star (6–7), M · Moon (8–10), L · Galaxy (11–12). Kids' cotton sleepwear is made to fit snugly; choose the child's usual size, don't size up. [Size guide](https://shopheyjude.com/size-guide)
- Care: machine wash cold, inside out; tumble dry low or hang dry; no bleach.

## How ordering works
- Pre-orders for the first drop are open on the website. Shoppers choose a size and quantity, add to their bag and send a pre-order request.
- You won’t be charged when you submit a request. We’ll email you to confirm what’s in stock, how you’ll receive your order, and your total, along with instructions for paying.
- Local delivery is free in much of the Denver metro area (about a 45-minute drive; eligible ZIP codes: 80002, 80010, 80011, 80012, 80013, 80014, 80015, 80016, 80017, 80018, 80019, 80022, 80030, 80033, 80104, 80108, 80109, 80110, 80111, 80112, 80113, 80116, 80120, 80121, 80122, 80123, 80124, 80125, 80126, 80127, 80128, 80129, 80130, 80134, 80138, 80202, 80203, 80204, 80205, 80206, 80207, 80209, 80210, 80211, 80212, 80214, 80215, 80216, 80218, 80219, 80220, 80221, 80222, 80223, 80224, 80226, 80227, 80228, 80229, 80230, 80231, 80232, 80235, 80236, 80237, 80238, 80239, 80241, 80246, 80247, 80249, 80260, 80640); everywhere else in the U.S. ships. Returns and exchanges are handled by mail; there is no physical store.
